breadcrumb: Std 8 Science (English) — Unit 16: Microorganisms — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Microorganisms are very small in size and can be seen only with the help of a microscope. The science that deals with the study of microorganisms is known as microbiology. Microorganisms can be studied under five categories: virus, bacteria, fungi, algae and protozoa.

en.q: Microorganisms are studied under ______ categories.
en.explanation: They are virus, bacteria, fungi, algae and protozoa.

ta.explanation: அவை வைரஸ், பாக்டீரியா, பூஞ்சை, பாசி, முதலுயிரிகள்.

questions.quote: Virus means 'poison' in Latin. Viruses are intracellular obligatory parasites. The study of virus is called virology. Viruses are 10,000 times smaller than bacteria.

en.q: According to the textbook, viruses are ______ times smaller than bacteria.
en.explanation: The study of viruses is called virology; 'virus' means poison in Latin.

ta.explanation: வைரஸ் பற்றிய படிப்பு வைராலஜி; 'வைரஸ்' என்றால் இலத்தீனில் நஞ்சு.

questions.quote: A virus contains a core DNA or RNA. Surrounding that core is a protein coat. In some viruses, the protein coat is covered by an envelope made of proteins, lipids and carbohydrates.

en.q: The core of a virus is made of ______.
en.explanation: It is surrounded by a protein coat (capsid).

ta.explanation: அது புரத உறையால் (கேப்சிட்) சூழப்பட்டுள்ளது.

questions.quote: Bacteria are single-celled prokaryotes. They are grouped under the kingdom Monera. The study of bacteria is called bacteriology. The size of bacteria ranges from 1 µm to 5 µm. Aerobic bacteria require oxygen; anaerobic bacteria do not.

en.q: Bacteria are grouped under the kingdom ______.
en.explanation: Protozoa are included under the kingdom Protista.

ta.explanation: முதலுயிரிகள் புரோடிஸ்டா திணையைச் சேர்ந்தவை.

questions.quote: Bacilli: rod shaped (Bacillus anthracis). Spirilla: spiral shaped (Helicobacter pylori). Cocci: spherical (diplococcus, streptococcus, staphylococcus). Vibrio: comma shaped (Vibrio cholera).

en.q: Vibrio cholerae, the cholera bacterium, is ______ in shape.
en.explanation: Bacillus anthracis is rod shaped; Helicobacter pylori is spiral.

ta.q: காலரா பாக்டீரியாவான விப்ரியோ காலரா ______ வடிவம் கொண்டது.
ta.explanation: பேசில்லஸ் ஆந்த்ராசிஸ் தண்டு வடிவம்; ஹெலிகோபாக்டர் பைலோரி சுருள் வடிவம்.

questions.quote: Photosynthetic bacteria make their own food (Eg. Cyanobacteria). Bacteria that live in harsh environment use chemicals (Ammonia, Hydrogen sulphide) to produce their food. This process is called chemosynthesis. Bacteria reproduce by fission (binary and multiple fission).

en.q: The process in which bacteria use chemicals like ammonia and hydrogen sulphide to produce food is called ______.
en.explanation: Bacteria reproduce by binary and multiple fission.

ta.q: அம்மோனியா, ஹைட்ரஜன் சல்பைடு போன்ற வேதிப்பொருள்களைக் கொண்டு பாக்டீரியா உணவு தயாரிக்கும் செயல்முறை ______ எனப்படும்.
ta.explanation: பாக்டீரியா இருமுறை, பலமுறைப் பிளவுறுதல் மூலம் இனப்பெருக்கம் செய்கின்றன.

questions.quote: Yeast is a unicellular fungus. It aids in fermentation with the help of the enzyme zymase. It respires anaerobically and reproduces by budding. Fungi lack chlorophyll and grow in dark environments; the study of fungi is called mycology.

en.q: Yeast reproduces by ______.
en.explanation: Yeast is a unicellular fungus that aids fermentation with the enzyme zymase.

ta.explanation: ஈஸ்ட் ஓரணு பூஞ்சை; ஸைமேஸ் நொதியால் நொதித்தலுக்கு உதவுகிறது.

questions.quote: Algae are very simple plant like eukaryotic organisms. They are rich in chlorophyll and can be seen as thin film on the surface of lakes and ponds. Therefore they are known as 'grass of water'. They are autotrophic. The study of algae is called algology (phycology).

en.q: Algae are known as the 'grass of water' because they ______.
options: are rich in chlorophyll and form a thin green film on lakes and ponds
en.explanation: Algae are autotrophic and produce their own food with chloroplasts.

options: பச்சையம் மிகுந்து ஏரி, குளங்களின் மேற்பரப்பில் மெல்லிய பச்சைப் படலமாகத் தோன்றுவது
ta.explanation: பாசிகள் தற்சார்பு ஊட்ட உயிரிகள்; பசுங்கணிகத்தால் உணவு தயாரிக்கின்றன.

questions.quote: Chlamydomonas is a simple, unicellular, motile fresh water algae. The cell wall is made of cellulose. The anterior part of the cell bears two flagella which helps in locomotion. The anterior side of the chloroplast contains a tiny red coloured eyespot.

en.q: Chlamydomonas moves with the help of ______.
en.explanation: It has a tiny red coloured eyespot in the chloroplast.

ta.explanation: அதன் பசுங்கணிகத்தில் சிறிய சிவப்பு நிறக் கண்புள்ளி உள்ளது.

questions.quote: Protozoa (in Greek, 'protos' means first and 'zoan' means animal) are single-celled eukaryotes included under the kingdom Protista. Types: Ciliates (Paramecium), Flagellates (Euglena), Pseudopods (Amoeba), Sporozoans (Plasmodium - parasites).

en.q: Amoeba moves with the help of ______.
en.explanation: Paramecium has cilia; Euglena has a flagellum; Plasmodium is a sporozoan parasite.

ta.explanation: பாரமீசியத்திற்கு இமைகள்; யூக்ளினாவுக்குச் கசையிழை; பிளாஸ்மோடியம் ஒட்டுண்ணி ஸ்போரோசோவான்.

questions.quote: The word prion is derived from 'proteinaceous infectious particle'. Prions have neither DNA nor RNA to transmit infection. Prions cause diseases by affecting brain or neural tissue. Eg. Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. Another example is Kuru - associated with cannibalism.

en.q: Kuru, a disease associated with cannibalism, is caused by ______.
en.explanation: Prions are proteinaceous infectious particles affecting brain tissue.

ta.q: மனித இனஉண்ணும் பழக்கத்துடன் தொடர்புடைய 'குரு' நோயை உண்டாக்குவது ______.
ta.explanation: பிரியான்கள் மூளை, நரம்புத் திசுக்களைப் பாதிக்கும் புரதத் தொற்றுத் துகள்கள்.

questions.quote: Virion is an entire virus particle consisting of an outer protein shell called a capsid and an inner core of nucleic acid (RNA or DNA). If the virus is found outside the cell (extracellular) it is known as virion.

en.q: The outer protein shell of a virion is called the ______.
en.explanation: The inner core of a virion is nucleic acid (RNA or DNA).

ta.explanation: விரியானின் உட்புற மையம் நியூக்ளிக் அமிலம் (RNA அல்லது DNA).

questions.quote: Sir Alexander Fleming was the first person to discover the antibiotic penicillin in the year 1928. It is used to treat diseases such as tetanus and diphtheria. Streptomycin is obtained from Streptomyces bacteria to cure bacterial infections like plague.

en.q: The antibiotic streptomycin is obtained from ______.
en.explanation: Penicillin comes from the fungus Penicillium chrysogenum.

ta.explanation: பெனிசிலின் பெனிசிலியம் பூஞ்சையிலிருந்து கிடைக்கிறது.

questions.quote: Vaccines are prepared from dead or weakened microbes. Edward Jenner was the first person to discover small pox vaccine. He coined the term vaccination. MMR vaccine is given for preventing Measles, Mumps and Rubella. BCG vaccine is given for preventing Tuberculosis.

en.q: The first person to discover the smallpox vaccine and coin the term 'vaccination' was ______.
en.explanation: BCG vaccine prevents tuberculosis.

ta.q: பெரியம்மைத் தடுப்பூசியை முதன்முதலில் கண்டறிந்து 'வாக்சினேஷன்' என்ற சொல்லை உருவாக்கியவர் ______.
ta.explanation: BCG தடுப்பூசி காசநோயைத் தடுக்கிறது.

questions.quote: Rhizobium bacteria living in the root nodules of leguminous plants enrich the soil by fixing the atmospheric nitrogen as nitrates. Some free living bacteria like Cyanobacteria fix nitrogen biologically. Bio-control agents: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt cotton) helps to control insects; Trichoderma (Fungi) protects roots; Baculoviruses attack insects.

en.q: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) is used in agriculture as a ______.
en.explanation: Trichoderma, a fungus, protects roots and controls plant pathogens.

ta.explanation: டிரைக்கோடெர்மா எனும் பூஞ்சை வேர்களைப் பாதுகாத்து நோய்க்காரணிகளைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துகிறது.

questions.quote: Human and animal faecal matter and plant wastes are broken down by anaerobic bacteria to produce methane (biogas) along with carbon dioxide and hydrogen. These bacteria are called methanogens. Yeast is used in bakeries to make bread and cakes; it produces carbon dioxide which makes the dough rise.

en.q: Bread dough rises because yeast produces ______.
en.explanation: Chlorella (green algae) is added to the dough to enrich bread with proteins and vitamins.

ta.explanation: புரதம், வைட்டமின் நிறைந்த குளோரெல்லா பாசி மாவில் சேர்க்கப்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: Lactose in the milk gets turned into lactic acid by the action of Lactobacillus (bacteria). Therefore, milk becomes thick (curd). When curd is processed, cottage cheese (panneer) is obtained. Lactobacillus acidophilus that lives in the human intestine helps in digestion of food. E. coli living in human intestine help in synthesizing vitamin K and vitamin B complex.

en.q: Milk is converted into curd by the action of ______.
en.explanation: Lactose in the milk is turned into lactic acid.

ta.explanation: பாலிலுள்ள லாக்டோஸ் லாக்டிக் அமிலமாக மாறுகிறது.

questions.quote: Pasteurization is a process for preservation of liquid food. It was invented by Louis Pasteur in 1862. Milk is heated up to 70 °C to kill bacteria and cooled to 10 °C to prevent the growth of remaining bacteria.

en.q: Pasteurization of milk was invented in 1862 by ______.
en.explanation: Milk is heated up to 70 °C and cooled to 10 °C.

ta.explanation: பால் 70°C வரை சூடாக்கப்பட்டுப் பின் 10°C-க்குக் குளிர்விக்கப்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: Table 16.2: Anthrax - Bacillus anthracis (bacteria) - anthrax vaccine; Foot and mouth disease - Aphthovirus (virus) - FMD vaccine. Table 16.3: Tuberculosis - Mycobacterium tuberculosis - BCG vaccine; Cholera - Vibrio cholerae; Common cold - Influenza virus; Rabies - Rhabdoviridae - anti-rabies vaccine; Amoebic dysentery - Entamoeba histolytica; Malaria - Plasmodium.

en.q: Amoebic dysentery is caused by ______.
en.explanation: Proper sanitation and metronidazole antibiotic are the preventive/treatment measures.

ta.explanation: முறையான சுகாதாரமும் மெட்ரோனிடசோல் நுண்ணுயிர்க்கொல்லியும் தடுப்பு/சிகிச்சை முறைகள்.

questions.quote: Rabies is caused by Rhabdo viridae (virus), transmitted by animal bite; symptoms are fever, hallucination, paralysis, inability to swallow. Foot and mouth disease is caused by Aphthovirus. Tuberculosis is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (bacteria), through air and sputum of an infected person.

en.q: Tuberculosis is caused by ______.
en.explanation: It spreads through air and sputum of an infected person; BCG vaccine prevents it.

ta.explanation: இது பாதிக்கப்பட்டவரின் காற்று, கபம் மூலம் பரவுகிறது; BCG தடுப்பூசி தடுக்கிறது.

questions.quote: Malaria: Plasmodium (protozoa), transmitted by the female Anopheles mosquito; symptoms - nausea, vomiting, high fever; antimalarial drugs like quinine and chloroquine, mosquito repellents and nets.

en.q: Which drugs are used against malaria?
en.explanation: Mosquito repellents and nets are also used.

ta.explanation: கொசு விரட்டிகளும் வலைகளும் கூடப் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன.

questions.quote: Thousands of bacteria, fungi and other microbes that live in our gut are essential contributors to good health. They break down toxins, manufacture some vitamins and essential amino acids and form a barrier against invaders.

en.q: Gut microbes help us by ______.
options: breaking down toxins and manufacturing some vitamins and essential amino acids
en.explanation: They also form a barrier against invaders.

options: நச்சுகளைச் சிதைத்தும் சில வைட்டமின்களையும் இன்றியமையா அமினோ அமிலங்களையும் உருவாக்கியும்
ta.explanation: அவை அத்துமீறுபவர்களுக்கு எதிரான தடையையும் ஏற்படுத்துகின்றன.

questions.quote: Bacteria is a prokaryotic, single celled organism. Fungi is a eukaryotic, non-photosynthetic, spore-forming organism. Algae is a single-celled or multicellular eukaryotic, photosynthetic organism. Protozoa is a eukaryotic, single celled organism that usually lacks chlorophyll.

en.q: Which of the following is a eukaryotic, non-photosynthetic, spore-forming organism?
en.explanation: Algae are eukaryotic and photosynthetic; bacteria are prokaryotic.

ta.q: உட்கருவுள்ள (யூகேரியோட்), ஒளிச்சேர்க்கை செய்யாத, வித்துகளை உருவாக்கும் உயிரி எது?
ta.explanation: பாசிகள் ஒளிச்சேர்க்கை செய்யும் யூகேரியோட்டுகள்; பாக்டீரியா புரோகேரியோட்.
